video_title: Luka Doncic Will RETIRE A Dallas Maverick???

quotes.speaker: Derek Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Derek Harper on Cooper Flagg's potential and development
quotes.excerpt: If Cooper stays in the gym all summer working on his jump shot, then I'll tell you to watch out NBA.
quotes.quote: I didn't know a whole lot about Cooper. I watched a lot of college basketball, but Cooper at the time, he didn't stand out to me in college like that. I knew he was good, I knew he was a pretty solid all-around player, but he was forced into a different role here, and he handled that role pretty well. I think if Cooper stays in the gym all summer working on his jump shot, then I'll tell you to watch out NBA.

quotes.speaker: Derek Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Derek Harper on the impact of the Luka Doncic trade
quotes.excerpt: I would not want my name on that trade if I ever had anything to do with the NBA.
quotes.quote: I love Nico, Nico is my buddy, but I would not want my name on that trade if I ever had anything to do with the NBA. You look back, you gave away what, 30 points, eight and nine, you gave it to somebody else for a guy that is no longer on your roster. That one is hard to get around. It is just something at the time I think they thought about doing and they were quick to react, and it just did not work out, especially here in Dallas. People love Luka here. I think he will eventually retire a Maverick.

quotes.speaker: Derek Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Debate on whether Cooper Flagg is a top 20 NBA player

text_blocks.speaker: Derek Harper
text_blocks.text: Is Cooper Flagg after the one this season a top 20 player in the league coming to the season?

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: I would say no. Just math alone, you got 24 All-Stars, he wasn't there. So just math alone, there's so many guys that he got to go through to crack that top 20 for me.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: I'm going to say yes, because I think he is going to be an All-Star in year two and I think he is going to make that leap that you talked about. And the way he finished this season at his age, his size, his skill set, I think if he stays healthy, I think he'll be top 20 going into next year.

quotes.speaker: Derek Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Derek Harper on Sam Cassell's potential as a head coach
quotes.excerpt: I think Sam is ready for a team, a young team that he can mold into what he wants.
quotes.quote: I think Sam Cassell at this stage of his coaching career, I think Sam is ready for a team, a young team that he can mold into what he wants. Sam is going to force you to play together, defend, and to me, young talent like Coop, I think Sam would fit well here in Dallas. I love Sam Cassell.
